 I download the IBM SPSS Modeler 17 trial version. but when I try to open it after setting up, it always show "No License Key Found".

ANSWER
The trial license is copied to the local hard drive as part of the IBM SPSS Modeler installation. To enable this license, please follow the steps below:

* Restart the License Authorization Wizard as an Administrator and select the Enable Trial option.
* You would now need to point to the location of the trial licence file (located in the installation directory of the Demo version of Modeler), do this by clicking on the ‘Open Folder’ icon and selecting the ‘temp.txt’ file.

RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
The following commands store the calendar week number of an SPSS date variable value into the new variable WEEKCAL. The principle is that if the weekday of the date is less than the weekday of Jan. 1 of that year, then the week number returned by XDATE.WEEK should be increased by 1 to reflect that a change in calendar week has occurred within an XDATE.WEEK week. The XDATE.WKDAY() functions returns a value in the range from 1 to 7 to reflect the weekday of the date variable in the parentheses. Sunday is assigned a value of 1; Saturday, a value of 7.

The command uses an SPSS date variable and the corresponding calendar year as inputs. DATEX and YEAR are used in this example. If you just have DATEX, you can compute YEAR with the command:

COMPUTE YEAR = XDATE.YEAR(DATEX).

If your date is just comprised of the separate variables DAY, MONTH, and YEAR, you compute DATEX with the command:

COMPUTE DATEX = DATE.DMY(DAY,MONTH,YEAR).

IBM SPSS: What is the Grace Period for SPSS License Codes - United States

TECHNOTE (TROUBLESHOOTING)

PROBLEM(ABSTRACT)
 What is the Grace Period for SPSS License Codes? How long are they and how do they work? 

RESOLVING THE PROBLEM
SPSS License Codes do not have a 'grace period'. When a SPSS product license expires, the product will cease to be licensed and will no longer function normally. One month prior to the expiration of the license, SPSS products will display a warning message indicating how much time remains before the license expires. This one month period is sometimes referred to as a 'grace period' however, there is no 'grace period'. If the product is not licensed with a new authorization code with a different (later) expiration date, the warning message will continue to display the number of days remaining for expiration until the license, in fact, expires. If/When the license expires, the SPSS product will no longer function instead displaying a startup message indicating the license has expired.

QUESTION
 I download the IBM SPSS Modeler 17 trial version. but when I try to open it after setting up, it always show "No License Key Found". 

How do I enable the 14-day trial license? 

ANSWER
The trial license is copied to the local hard drive as part of the IBM SPSS Modeler installation. To enable this license, please follow the steps below: 
* Please ensure that you don't have any open windows of IBM SPSS Modeler running.
* Restart the License Authorization Wizard as an Administrator and select the Enable Trial option.
* You would now need to point to the location of the trial licence file (located in the installation directory of the Demo version of Modeler), do this by clicking on the ‘Open Folder’ icon and selecting the ‘temp.txt’ file.
- By default, the installation directory for Windows would be: C:\Program Files\IBM\SPSS\Modeler\xx\bin (where ‘xx’ is your version number)
* Complete the rest of the wizard and restart IBM SPSS Modeler, you should now be able to use the application for 14 days.
